svg.text: PHASE B ROUTING CHOICE · ENGINEERING + MAINTENANCE · REFINEMENT V2
Placed objects on the post-rescale grid · hand carry within rooms · tubes between departments
Engineering is the three-screen thermal row beside one
listing-impact press. Maintenance is the caged parts
wall beside one fixed service bed.
The screens remain blank glass. Parts and tools are not
baked clutter. Work identity stays on the standardized
accepted static control · Terrarium promotion authorized
